rules.neo_to_key: InputUnit immutable flags, fresh Learn flags, remove source block groups whose application object equals a concrete secondary application, then source slots0..3 + slot8 + 255*3; Area slot8 is outside eight block removal; brightness enabled
rules.pci_dali: Both tweaker classes swap two Application elements as decimal second, space, first; no target conversion-hook override; Burden immutable and destination-only fields retain defaults
rules.pir: Older PIR uses CoreKey+Learn, no dual application/Neo reshape; brightness false; EEPROMLevelStore, InfraRedBank, LightIndex, LightLevel, LightLevelStore1, LightLevelStore2 immutable; source is never ST7
rules.senll: Older SENLL invokes Learn only; the ST7 source translation branch is not reached. The no-op tweaker mapping is fallback-only when a target name is absent in source
rules.multisensor: Older multisensor invokes CoreKey then re-enables DisableIR; brightness false. Source older SENLL has no GroupAddress; original fresh empty string plus IntArrayElementWithDefault(255) generates nine255 values. IsJoinModeSupported compares firmware to2.0.0:1.6.00 forces four join fields255; ST7-only lux translation is not reached

limits: Static source and private catalogue/specification shape reads only; no original/native/GUI/hardware execution.
Fixed selected firmware profiles do not establish every sensor firmware, retained editor history or source application-model exception behavior.
NeoToKey requires a concrete primary application; its runtime application objects are reconstructed from complete admitted PP identities, not a captured original in-memory process.
Private vendor specification/catalogue text and original instruction bytes are not bundled.
